header.title: Start your 5GDHC journey
header.body: Screen a site with the Quick Check, develop a Business Plan, or both. Everything you enter stays in this browser.

continue.welcomeBody: Pick a path below to start a new project, or open one of the examples to see a finished screening.

paths.title: Start a new project
paths.body: Choose what you want to work on. You can turn modules on or off later.

quick-check.title: Quick Check
quick-check.body: Screen the site's potential for a 5GDHC network in four steps and see the decisive factors.

business-plan.title: Business Plan
business-plan.body: Develop a business model step by step: value, investment, risk and responsibility.

both.title: Both
both.body: Screen the site first, then build the business model on the same data.

newProject.title: Name your project
newProject.body: You can rename it at any time.
newProject.label: Project name
newProject.failed: The project could not be created. Try again.

examples.title: Examples
examples.body: Six illustrative projects with both modules filled in. Opening one creates your own copy.

import.title: Import a project
import.body: Drop a .firstmove.json file here, or choose one. Files are checked and never leave this browser.
import.drop: Drop the file to import it

projects.title: Your projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Start one above or open an example.
